title: Banff National Park and Lake Louise Small Group Tour
blurb:
-Viator Experience Award Winner
-Family-Owned & Operated
-Certified Local Guides Born & Raised in the Rockies

Experience Banff National Park the way it was meant to be explored. More than just transportation between viewpoints, our small-group tours are fully guided experiences where local stories, wildlife, history, and genuine hospitality bring the Canadian Rockies to life.

Visit iconic destinations including Lake Louise, Johnston Canyon, Banff Town, Bow Falls, and Surprise Corner while enjoying scenic drives, short walks, plenty of photo opportunities, and time to truly appreciate each stop. We take care of the planning, driving, and logistics so you can simply relax and enjoy the journey.

• Small groups with personalized service
• Wildlife viewing opportunities & photography assistance
• Relaxed lunch break and free time in Banff Town
• Convenient departures from Calgary, Canmore & Banff
